lead_raw_text:
The structure of ErAlSi₂ is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119), containing 16 atoms per unit cell (Er₄Al₄Si₈) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Er each coordinated by nine Si neighbors, while Si centers have 13 geometric neighbors (4 Al, 4 Er, 5 Si), with neighbor distances ranging from 2.7599 to 3.24 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Er- and Si-centered 9- and 13-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing among Al-centered 9-vertex polyhedra.
